# Retailed

Retailed is a global developer-first platform providing retail and resale marketplace APIs with access to product data, pricing information, and inventory management from major platforms like StockX, GOAT, Chrono24, and 50+ retail websites including sneakers, streetwear, watches, and luxury goods.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/retailed/.

## Actions

- **Get API Usage** (read-only): Retrieve current api usage statistics.
- **Get GOAT Product Prices** (read-only): Retrieve pricing information for a specific product on goat.
- **Get StockX Product** (read-only): Retrieve detailed stockx product information.
- **StockX Search** (read-only): Search stockx marketplace for products and pricing information.
- **StockX Trends** (read-only): Get the latest trending products from stockx.
- **Search Products** (read-only): Search for products in retailed matching query criteria.
